description: W048 desktop journey records (headless product-logic runs over the embedded gateway + real fixtures)

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
actions: record the W017 shell session snapshot
records.expectedOutcome: session issued; project node resolved; world digest equals the fixture registry digest; W017 shell session snapshot recorded
records.disposition: PASS (Onboard/project entry) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: a session issues from the fixture authentication result
the project node resolves and the world digest matches the fixture registry
the W017 shell records a content-addressed session snapshot

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)

records.expectedOutcome: world entities + fixture evidence render; new evidence intakes with an authority-computed digest

steps.expected: entities project; the fixture evidence record resolves
new evidence bytes are digested by the authority (digest recomputed server-side)
the view model separates knowns from unknowns

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)

actions: execute it through the Action Gateway
records.expectedOutcome: constraint + verification evaluate; the action submits, gains human approval, executes and reports status — all through the Action Gateway

steps.expected: the constraint authority evaluates the compiled constraint
the verification authority validates the chain
the action runs ONLY through the Action Gateway (submit -> human approval -> execute)

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
records.expectedOutcome: solution re-seals to the fixture digest; baseline approves; schedule folds; the quote admits through the procurement authority
records.disposition: PASS (Program of Work, BOQ/domain schedule and acquisition/procurement) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the solution seals (digest matches the fixture) and the baseline approves
the BOQ/schedule folds project (quantity/cost/milestones)
the supplier quote seals + admits through the procurement authority

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
records.expectedOutcome: delivery opens; two field observations intake; the forecast rolls; verification validates; the delivery closes
records.disposition: PASS (Realize, field observation, actualization, verification and forecast) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the delivery record opens through the solution-delivery authority
both field observations intake through the execution-tracking authority
the rolling forecast computes through the actualization authority
the chain validates and the delivery closes

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
actions: reconnect and drain through the gateway
records.expectedOutcome: pending projection survives offline; the drain fails transiently; reconnect drains exactly once; the replay returns the recorded outcome; no local semantic store
records.disposition: PASS (Offline work, queue, reconnect, idempotent sync) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the intent is admitted as a PENDING projection (never applied locally)
the drain fails transiently; the intent stays pending
the intent drains through the Action Gateway path with its idempotency key (exactly once)
the replay returns the RECORDED outcome (replayed: true) — never double-apply
the local durable store holds ONLY projection/queue records — no world/solution/delivery truth

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
actions: admit the server projection into the cache
records.expectedOutcome: identical authoritative state across devices (digest equality with the registry); identical session scope; the server projection admits into the read-only cache
records.disposition: PASS (Cross-device handoff) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the desktop receives the SAME world digest as the web product (the fixture registry anchor)
the session scope (principal + tenant) is identical across devices
the local projection cache admits the server projection by digest (read-only, immutable)
the handoff descriptor exports through the file picker and re-imports with the same digest

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
actions: run the supervision check over the fixture program + delivery
records.expectedOutcome: the supervision pass evaluates over the fixture program/delivery; the alert raises through the alert authority
records.disposition: PASS (Agent supervision/intervention) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the supervision authority evaluates the pass over the fixture program + delivery
the alert authority raises the supervision alert

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
records.expectedOutcome: session expiry -> re-authentication; connector failure -> retry-with-backoff; retry succeeds; the authority rejection rides verbatim
records.observedOutcome: j11-1-no-session=pass, j11-2-reauthenticate=pass, j11-3-connector-failure=pass, j11-4-retry-succeeds=pass, j11-5-authority-rejection=pass, j11-6-recovery-log=pass
records.disposition: PASS (Recovery from network/session/input/action/connector/evidence failures) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the typed auth-session-expired error surfaces; the recovery action is re-authenticate
a fresh session issues from the verified authentication result
the transient error class surfaces; the recovery action is retry-with-backoff
the retried call succeeds through the same bridge
the authority rejection surfaces with the authority error verbatim (never a client-local semantic error)
every failure maps to a typed recovery event

records.environment: Node/vitest headless product-logic run: embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition) + memory host (durable store semantics) + frozen journey clock; native Tauri shell covered by config validation (no cargo/webkit2gtk in this environment)
preconditions: the W046 product fixtures (registry-verified digests)
the embedded fixture-backed Application Gateway (W046 single-process composition)
records.expectedOutcome: launch -> work -> close -> relaunch restores session + queue; the compatible update passes; the incompatible one is refused; the queue drains exactly once after relaunch
records.observedOutcome: j12-1-launch-work=pass, j12-2-close=pass, j12-3-relaunch-restore=pass, j12-4-update-compatible=pass, j12-5-update-refusal=pass, j12-6-queue-survives=pass
records.disposition: PASS (Install -> launch -> work -> close -> relaunch -> update) — headless product-logic run over the embedded gateway + real fixtures; native shell covered by config validation (see environment)

steps.expected: the product launches, authenticates and works (project entered)
the session snapshot records; queue + session persist for relaunch
the relaunch restores the session and the pending offline queue from durable state
the compatible candidate passes the protocol gate
the incompatible protocol envelope is REFUSED (never opened)
the pending intent survives the relaunch and drains exactly once
